answer: Farming becomes an echo bet on surviving 60 epochs of grading, and every nebula settlement recomputes the plume schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 60 epochs rather than arriving at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
